The NMIMS online BBA does not offer any direct placement assistance to the students. However, it offers access to the alumni portal along with career services, which include targeted assessments, personalized coaching, and professional development tools.

Some of the major career services offered for the NMIMS online BBA program are:

  • Access to job portal
  • One on one personalized guidance/coaching
  • Profile development
  • Practie interviews
  • Cognitive and behavioral skill assessment

Simultaneously, 98% of students enrolled in NMIMS online BBA admit that they have witnessed a positive impact on their careers. The institution has also partnered with multiple MNCs, corporations, and start-ups that actively recruit skilled professionals. Some of the active recruiting partners are as follows:

  • Mindteck
  • RBS
  • Vaya
  • Helix Tech
  • Milkbasket, etc

data.eligibility_content:
To enroll in the NMIMS online BBA program, interested students are required to fulfil the following eligibility criteria:

The applicants must have completed a 10+2 educational qualification from a recognised board in any discipline.

A minimum of 50% aggregate marks at the 10+2 qualification is mandatory (45% for reserved category students).
data.admission_steps:
The entire NMIMS online BBA admission process is mentioned below to ensure a hassle-free enrolment process for interested students:

  1. Step 1. Visit the official website of NMIMS CDOE and complete the registration process by paying the admission processing fee.
  2. Step 2. Select online BBA along with your preferred specialization and start filling out the online application form.
  3. Step 3. Attach the supporting documents along with the online application form.
  4. Step 4. Pay the course fee as per your chosen plan.
  5. Step 5. Submit the application and wait for confirmation.
  6. Step 6. Once the university verifies your application and documents, a confirmation letter is provided to your registered email.

data.about_content:
Course Details

The NMIMS online BBA in business analytics is a 3 year undergraduate degree course that is delivered through a 100% online learning platform. The course allows students to learn at their own pace, and it offers maximum flexibility with its 6 year validity.

The NMIMS online BBA in business analytics course develops a foundational understanding of core business management aspects with a blend of in-depth concepts of business analytics such as data management, big data technologies, machine learning, and others.

Students enrolled in the NMIMS online BBA in business analytics are guided by industry experts to develop and apply business models and frameworks to solve real-world business problems. The course is designed in such a way that it enhances the employability skills of enrolled students to ensure a promising future.

data.emi_content: The NMIMS online BBA does not offer EMI or loan assistance directly. Students can opt for third-party financial assistance or scholarships. Payment plans available: Semester-wise (INR 30,000), Annually (INR 56,400), or One-time payment (INR 1,45,000).
data.exam_content:
The NMIMS online courses examination process is similar for both UG and PG programs. The exams are conducted through an online proctored platform that allows students to appear for the examinations from any corner of the globe; they only need a good internet connection, a laptop, and a working webcam.

The NMIMS online examinations follow an evaluation method of IA + TEE, which stands for Internal Assessment + Term End Examinations.

data.syllabus_content:
The NMIMS online BBA in business analytics syllabus spans over 3 years, consisting of 6 semesters, and each semester includes 6 subjects, which totals to 144 program credits. The initial 3 semesters completely focus on the core management and business administration subjects, whereas the term-end semester includes the industry-oriented electives.

For your consideration, the entire course syllabus is listed below:

Year I

Semester I

  • Principles of Management
  • Business Communication
  • Financial Accounting
  • Micro Economics
  • Organisation Behaviour & HRM
  • Essentials of IT

Semester II

  • Cost and Management Accounting
  • Principles of Marketing
  • Operations Research
  • Macro Economics
  • Business Statistics for Decision Making
  • Introduction to Analytics

Year II

Semester III

  • Business and Allied Law
  • Digital Marketing
  • Financial Management
  • Consumer Behaviour
  • International Business & Export Import Management
  • Sales Management

Semester IV

  • Production & Total Quality Management
  • Research Methodology
  • Introduction to Python
  • Machine Learning –I
  • Data Visualisation with Tableau
  • Multivariate Techniques

Year III

Semester V

  • Entrepreneurship Management
  • Project
  • Customer Relationship Management
  • Analytics in Business domains
  • Data Management
  • Machine Learning -II

Semester VI

  • Business Ethics and Corporate Governance
  • Strategic Management
  • Operations and Supply Chain Management
  • Project Management
  • Introduction to Big Data Technologies
  • Time Series Forecasting
